name: Desun Real Estate Investment Services Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Desun Real Estate Investment Services Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in China. The company operates through three segments: Property Services, Asset Operation Services, and Investment and Development. It manages various properties, including residential, institutional, block commercial and urban complex, industrial park, and office properties; and offers value-added services, such as market research, investment promotion, sale of field property, warranty repairs, housing brokerage, and public space advertising, as well as planning, store display, leasing, green plants and decoration leasing, hosting conferences, and reception services.
